Each block applies `sumOptionSpecialization_stableOrZero`, splits into zero or stable, rewrites with `partialSpecialization_option`, and in the zero case closes with `partialSpecialization_zero`. A one-layer lemma would take the induction step to `Option κ` and be applied twice. That is credible and would remove the hand-written `change`/`let` bookkeeping. Two things stop me from confirming it. (1) The rubric asks for reasoning repeated in at least two proofs. Here both copies are inside one proof, and the helper is only used twice, in that one place. `pairVariables_partialSpecialization_stableOrZero` is the only caller of `partialSpecialization_option`. A second consumer of the lemma exists nowhere in the file, so I cannot cite two distinct proofs. (2) The nontrivial mathematics is already in `sumOptionSpecialization_stableOrZero`, `sumOptionSpecialization_multiaffine` and `partialSpecialization_option`. What repeats is mostly case-splitting and rewriting around those lemmas, which is close to the rubric's excluded category of moving duplicated branches into a helper. The candidate's lemma is also not as stated. `sumOptionSpecialization_stableOrZero` requires `[Finite κ]` as well as `[Finite τ]`, so the helper needs `[Finite κ]` too. That is harmless, because `PairVariables n` has a Fintype instance, but the candidate omitted it. Whether a within-proof duplication of this plumbing counts is a judgement about the rubric that the source cannot settle. I make no claim that the rewrite compiles.

theorem optionPartialSpecialization_stableOrZero {κ τ : Type*} [Finite κ] [Finite τ]
    (ih : ∀ (q : MvPolynomial (κ ⊕ τ) ℂ) (y : κ → ℝ), IsComplexMultiaffine q → IsUpperHalfPlaneStable q →
      partialSpecialization q y = 0 ∨ IsUpperHalfPlaneStable (partialSpecialization q y))
    (p : MvPolynomial (Option κ ⊕ τ) ℂ) (x : Option κ → ℝ)
    (hmulti : IsComplexMultiaffine p) (hstable : IsUpperHalfPlaneStable p) :
    partialSpecialization p x = 0 ∨ IsUpperHalfPlaneStable (partialSpecialization p x) := by
  rcases sumOptionSpecialization_stableOrZero p (x none) hmulti hstable with h0 | h1
  · left; rw [partialSpecialization_option p x hmulti, h0, partialSpecialization_zero]
  · rw [partialSpecialization_option p x hmulti]
    exact ih _ _ (sumOptionSpecialization_multiaffine p (x none) hmulti) h1
